checks.reason: The reviewer moved this to study-of-compounds-hydrogen-chloride, but the question tests the reactivity series (which metal gives H2 with dilute acid, and which metal oxide H2 can reduce), which is Metallurgy content; the correction is doubtful and the original metallurgy mapping is at least as good.

The paper prints the ion charges as 2Br1– and Cl1– in all three pdftotext modes, but the pack stores them as 2Br-1 and Cl-1, which changes the printed notation (and its own extractionIssues says Br1–/Cl1–).

The stored text "Zinc oxide is treated with caustic alkali." drops the shared instruction "Write balanced chemical equations for the following:", so on its own it does not say what the student has to do.

The stored text "Laboratory preparation of nitric acid using sodium nitrate." drops the shared instruction "Write balanced chemical equations for the following:", so it does not stand alone; it is also on page 8 of the PDF, not page 9 as stored.
